fund_switch.risk_foreign_start: In processing the fund transaction, I acknowledge the following risks.
fund_switch.foreign_note:
In the case that I choose to invest in mutual funds with foreign investment policies

I acknowledge that the mutual fund I choose is not fully hedged against currency exchange risks. This means that I may either gain or lose from currency exchange fluctuations and may receive returns in an amount lower than the initial investment. I confirm my wish to invest in the mutual fund I have chosen.
fund_switch.risk_note:
In the case that I choose a mutual fund with a higher level of risk than I can accept,

I acknowledge that the mutual fund I choose has a level of risk higher than what I can invest in. I have already studied the prospectus related to the risk level of the mutual fund I would like to invest in, and I confirm my wish to invest in the chosen mutual fund.
fund_switch.risk_foreign_note_remind: Please carefully study and understand about fund information, terms and conditions regarding investment returns, and risks involved in the prospectus before making an investment decision.

fund_switch.list_info: Fund switch allows you to reallocate your investment by transferring a percentage or number of units from a fund to another.
fund_switch.notice_desc_part1: Unit balance is subject to pending buy/sell transactions. If the units requested to switch out are more than the outstanding unit balance, the company will deem to switch out all of the fund’s actual unit balance.
fund_switch.notice_desc_part2: The company will purchase the investment units of the destination fund on the working day that the company receives the redemption proceeds of each fund from the fund, according to the timeframe specified in the prospectus. If the purchase/redemption date of the investment units of any funds is a holiday, the company will purchase/redeem the investment units of that fund on the next working day that the transaction can be processed
